lot.objective: Migrate a coherent validation slice, starting with contracts and base rules before their implementations.

classes.notes: Root validation contract. Migrate before every implementation in this lot and verify external implementers remain compatible through the legacy interface alias.
File-validation contract extending Validate. Migrate after the root contract and before document validators in later lots.
Validation-rule contract. Migrate before Simple, Composite, and Chain.
Basic Rule implementation with focused test coverage. Verify callback signatures conservatively.
Composite Rule implementation. Preserve the accepted rule collection shape and evaluation order.
Consumer of validation rules. Migrate after the Rule contract and implementations, preserving chain order and error behavior.
Small leaf implementation of Validate. Preserve WordPress-style empty-value semantics.
Leaf validator using regular-expression configuration. Verify nullable matches and preg_match return handling before typing.
Base URL validator with focused tests and a subclass in this lot. Migrate before TileLayerUrl and preserve its extension contract.
Url subclass with focused tests. Migrate after Url and verify both new and legacy inheritance checks.
